data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕分体式空调的本地化接入、DIY控制、精细温控与设备兼容性展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 本地化改造派：通过 ESP32、CN105/M-NET、ESPHome、HomeKit、Matter 或红外实现 Home Assistant 接入，强调免云端、可定制和隐私。相关项目包括 Serin Labs、minisplit-local、HeishaMon，以及 Flipper/Tasmota 红外方案。  
• 一体化方案派：akifbayram提供 NanoC6、AtomS3 Lite 的套件、网页刷机和 YAML 生成器，并开发可统一控制多区域的总线设备，可读取压力、温度、功率、压缩机频率和故障码。  
• 精细控制派：认为部分机型温控误差可达约 2°C、缺少良好 PID，提出模拟温度、调整设定值、改传感器、接管压缩机或逆向红外等方案；也有人希望限制 Airbnb 用户可设置的温度范围。  
• 实用主义/反智能派：认为 HVAC 应“设定后不管”，传统 Honeywell 恒温器更可靠耐用，不希望引入复杂的“智能”控制。  
• 选型与兼容性关注：指出 Mitsubishi Electric 与 Mitsubishi Heavy Industries 并非同一品牌，接口可能使用不同 JST 规格；也有人询问 Bosch 等品牌是否支持类似改造，并担忧厂商收取云服务月费。

补充讨论：讨论还延伸到隐藏式空调在欧洲住宅中的特殊布线背景，以及用 ESP32 改造咖啡机等家电的类似思路。争议焦点主要是“本地控制的灵活性与隐私”是否值得付出安装复杂度、可靠性和潜在安全风险。

• 选型与兼容性关注：指出 Mitsubishi Electric 与 Mitsubishi Heavy Industries 并非同一品牌，接口可能使用不同 JST 规格；也有人询问 Bosch 等品牌是否支持类似改造，并担忧厂商收取云服务月费。

补充讨论：讨论还延伸到隐藏式空调在欧洲住宅中的特殊布线背景，以及用 ESP32 改造咖啡机等家电的类似思路。争议焦点主要是“本地控制的灵活性与隐私”是否值得付出安装复杂度、可靠性和潜在安全风险。

data.title: The Interim Computer Museum
data.author: mulmen
data.article_summary: 临时计算机博物馆（ICM）通过结合老式硬件与现代技术的互动展览，保存并分享计算机发展史，为参观者提供连接过去与现在的实践体验。博物馆是与SDF公共UNIX系统合作的非营利机构，依靠会员、社区活动、远程访问和文物保护维持运营。访客可了解参观预约、捐赠、加入会员及订阅 newsletter 等信息。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕复古计算机博物馆及其收藏、修复、教育传播价值展开，重点涉及参观体验、馆藏遗产和相关机构推荐。

不同观点：
• 高度赞赏保存工作：评论者称其收藏“精彩”、尤其重视企业级等容易被废弃的机器；馆长 Stephen 即使筹备计算机节，也亲自进行了1.5小时动手参观并演示《Spacewar》，体现出对保护和科普的投入。  
• 鼓励实地或线上参观：多人计划下次去西雅图，建议查看 Recollections 页面登录真实的老式 Unix 电脑；博物馆还通过 YouTube 展示 KL-10 等设备。有人建议周六参观 ICM、周日参观 Connections Museum，每处预留2至4小时，且靠近机场，适合转机短访。  
• 强调博物馆网络与遗产延续：推荐西雅图 Connections Museum、亚特兰大的 MIMMS Museum、悉尼 Australian Computer Museum，并认为部分馆藏来自 LCM，其影响仍在延续。另有评论将硬件博物馆与保存源代码的 Programming Museum 相联系。  
• 从个人记忆和历史兴趣出发：有人回忆少年时代使用 PLATO 网络游戏时跨地域交流的震撼；也有人希望看到 Vannevar Bush 相关机器及其与早期国家安全机构的历史。  
• 提出轻松的实际疑问：有人认为博物馆把个人收藏癖转化为社会教育很有意义，但调侃多年使用后键盘如何保持清洁。

补充讨论：评论者还指出该博物馆此前曾在2023年被讨论，整体舆论几乎一致支持，争议主要不在价值，而在参观便利性、馆藏范围及维护细节。

data.title: Revolut confirms customer data breach through fake government requests
data.author: tdrz
data.article_summary: 金融科技公司Revolut确认，因诈骗者利用合法政府机构的官方邮箱域名发出虚假信息请求，公司向未经授权的第三方泄露了少量客户数据。泄露信息包括身份及联系方式、护照和驾照复印件，或还涉及自拍、账单和交易记录。Revolut已通知受影响客户、封锁相关邮箱，并向政府机构、执法部门及监管机构报告，称系统和客户资金未受影响。公司未公布受影响人数及涉事机构。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕 Revolut 因伪造或疑似政府执法请求而泄露客户身份、交易及可能的比特币信息，讨论其验证流程、数据安全和透明度责任。

不同观点：
• **合规流程存在根本缺陷**：不能仅因邮件来自真实政府域名、通过 DKIM 或带有公文抬头，就认定请求合法；应通过官网公布的电话回拨、可核验的案件编号和固定渠道确认授权，并限制紧急请求的数据范围。  
• **责任归属存在争议**：有人认为若邮件通过 DKIM，可能意味着政府邮箱或服务器被攻破，主要责任在政府；若仅依赖 SPF，则仍可能被利用，Revolut难辞其咎。  
• **企业透明度和用户信任不足**：Revolut只称“少量”客户受影响，不公布人数、市场及涉事机构；客服还笼统表示数据“安全”，导致用户无法核实自己是否受影响。  
• **数据留存过度**：评论质疑为何长期保存验证自拍、护照等敏感资料；若连同交易记录泄露，尤其是比特币地址与身份的对应关系，链上信息永久存在，风险难以消除。  
• **通知与邮件管理不当**：支付回执、垃圾邮件和重要安全通知使用同一发件地址，降低用户识别真实通知的能力。  
• **更广泛的制度担忧**：政府调取私人数据被视为一种“后门”，不存在只允许“好人”使用的后门。

补充讨论：争议焦点是事件究竟属于政府邮箱被攻破、邮件伪造，还是 Revolut 对合法性审查和权限控制失效；多数评论认为核心问题不只是钓鱼，而是“身份认证被误当作授权认证”。

49682087.article_content:
British fintech Revolut confirmed that it disclosed sensitive customer information to an unauthorized third party after receiving fraudulent requests sent from a legitimate government agency email domain.
The exposed data included customers’ identity and contact details, including their birth date, postal and email addresses, and phone numbers, as well as copies of their identity documents including passports and driver’s licenses, according to a notification emailed to affected customers and reviewed by TechCrunch. The data may have also included verification selfies, account statements, and transaction histories, the firm said in its notification.
A Revolut spokesperson confirmed to TechCrunch that a “limited” number of customers were impacted and said the company had contacted those customers directly. Revolut, however, did not disclose the exact number of impacted individuals. It also did not answer whether the incident was limited to a specific market and declined to disclose the government agency involved.
“Revolut recently identified a sophisticated external impersonation scam where an unauthorised third party utilised a legitimate government agency domain email to submit fraudulent requests for information,” the spokesperson said.
Revolut told TechCrunch that it blocked the email address after discovering the scam from the unauthorized third party and alerted the relevant government agency, law enforcement, and relevant regulators, adding, “Revolut systems and customer funds are unaffected.”
London-based Revolut has
more than 80 million customers
globally and operates as a bank in more than 30 countries, per its website. The fintech recently
expanded its presence
in markets including India, Mexico, France, and the UAE. Moreover, earlier this month, the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
granted
a conditional approval to Revolut to set up a national bank in the country, which the firm expects to launch in the first half of 2027.
Well-known crypto security researcher ZachXBT
posted about Revolut’s email
to its affected customers late on Friday. The researcher said the incident appeared to have been targeted at high net worth users.
The incident comes as Revolut reportedly weighs a potential public listing that could value it at
as much as $200 billion
, up from its
$75 billion private valuation
in November. The fintech has also been expanding its banking footprint in Europe and globally, securing banking licenses in France and the UK in recent months.

data.title: Don't be the out of touch Kung Fu master
data.author: dsubburam
data.article_summary: 卡马克借《五轮书》感慨：武术曾从实战技能演变为体育、兴趣与传统，编程也可能因AI而经历类似变化。手写代码的重要性将下降，但旧技能仍可作为爱好保留。程序员应拥抱新工具，避免固守过时技艺而脱离现实。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕约翰·卡马克转向AGI及AI编程的价值、风险与“传统程序员是否会被淘汰”展开讨论，核心是效率提升与基础能力、软件控制权之间的张力。

不同观点：
• 怀疑者认为卡马克自AI兴起后缺乏可见成果，AI可能让人“迷失在细节中”，产生忙碌感却降低生产力；也有人认为编程不应只追求生成更多代码，学习与思考本身同样重要。  
• 支持AI辅助编程者认为，AI能免除语法、API、库陷阱和编辑器操作等重复劳动，让工程师专注数据结构、架构和算法；纯“氛围编程”尚不适合复杂系统，但辅助式AI已重新激发编程兴趣。  
• 谨慎派担心新一代跳过数据结构、并发、网络等基础知识，长期削弱判断和维护能力。资深开发者目前多把AI当增强版Stack Overflow，不愿将多年代码库交给不透明工具，也不确定是否值得彻底改变工作方式。  
• 变革派认为拒绝AI会像固守传统武术，最终被新技术超越；但反对者指出软件开发是协作而非竞争，“功夫大师对战MMA”的比喻并不恰当，AI更像不了解原理却能部署强大工具的人。

John Carmack on X: "I recently went through a translation of Musashi’s Book of Five Rings.
The introduction chronicled the evolution of swordsmanship and martial arts in general from pragmatic battlefield necessities to sports, historical curiosities, and hobbies. It was interesting to hear how in the post-WW2 occupation when martial arts were banned, Judo was represented as equivalent to western wrestling, and Kendo later to western fencing.
The poignant undercurrent for me is that I can see many programming skills following that path.
There are probably dozens of people reading this that remember hand assembling opcodes to hex and still have some magic numbers burned into their memory, but even the small group of people still programming in assembly today (hey, @FFmpeg !) don’t work at that primitive level now.
AI is making many other programming skills much less critical. We aren’t there yet, but carefully writing code completely by hand is moving from a -jitsu to a -do. Code-do? Codo?
That’s ok! The retro computing scene is delightful, full of people building and exercising old skills for the love of it.
But don’t be the out of touch Kung Fu master, heir to lifetimes of tradition, that gets mauled by an amateur MMA fighter.
Musashi would probably have been pretty enthusiastic about assault rifles."

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“是否应放缓AI发展”及相关呼吁的真实动机展开争论，焦点在安全、国家竞争与利益控制之间。

不同观点：
• **地缘政治与权力控制论**：放缓面向公众的AI，可能让政府或少数公司掌握更先进的能力，形成与公众、其他国家的能力差距；“AI安全”或许是控制关键技术、限制中国模型的政策工具，而非单纯安全考量。  
• **竞争与资本约束论**：Anthropic等公司即使呼吁放缓，也难获股东同意，因为这会损害领先地位和股价；美国政府也不会容忍中国借机赶超，因此“暂停”很难真正执行。  
• **利益冲突与虚伪论**：有人讽刺“大家都该慢下来，除了我”，认为领先者更容易提出刹车要求；所谓安全倡导者可能实际想成为技术和权力的掌控者。  
• **怀疑AI末日论**：部分评论认为这是道德恐慌或宣传戏剧，回顾GPT-2禁发、AI觉醒等历次危言，预言几年后会被嘲笑；真正的突破可能来自模型之上的软件层，而非模型本身。  
• **谨慎担忧论**：也有人确实感到AI进步过快、未来难以预测，担心失控或“AI反叛”，希望人类谨慎治理。

补充讨论：争议核心是“放缓”究竟出于公共安全，还是服务于国家竞争、商业利益和少数主体垄断；评论中还以“猫娘/猫耳”等玩笑讽刺末日叙事和安全宣传。

主要讨论点：对遥远黑洞观测成果的惊叹、科学观测可信度的质疑，以及相关资料与科幻联想。

不同观点：
• **惊叹观测能力**：dotancohen认为最令人震撼的不只是研究结论，而是观测本身。目标黑洞位于约2000万光年外的另一星系，科学家仍能通过多次高分辨率观测推断气体如何围绕黑洞运行并被其拖曳，体现了现代天文学的观测能力。  
• **宇宙尺度下的渺小感**：Towaway69分享Legacy Survey图像链接，并指出缩小视野后，人类在宇宙中的“微不足道”更加直观。  
• **对天文学结论的强烈质疑**：ahhrealmonsters认为，人类尚未充分探索地球海洋、天气预报也不完善，却常对遥远行星的化学成分和天气做出确定描述；当多年后修正甚至推翻“行星”判断时，质疑此前为何以确定口吻宣传，批评其中存在夸大和误导。  
• **资料补充与科幻联想**：wglb提供论文ArXiv链接；caffeinejunk1e仅提到科幻小说《挽救计划》，可能是在联想到黑洞、宇宙探索等主题。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于科学推断的合理范围与公众传播中的确定性表述。评论者一方面惊叹观测技术，另一方面担心媒体或科学家将基于模型的推测包装成绝对事实。

data.title: Mars astronauts could live in houses made of yeast and jello, say scientists
data.author: Bender
data.article_summary: 香港研究人员提出用工程化酵母、明胶和火星土壤，通过低能耗3D打印建造栖身结构。材料在火星低温干燥环境中冻干后，强度接近低等级混凝土，能耗远低于加热处理土壤，且可回收利用。但目前仅在实验室制作了微型结构，气密性、保温、抗辐射等实用性能仍需验证，未来可能需与传统材料结合。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：酵母-明胶生物泡沫能否用于月球或火星建筑，以及其实际应用价值与局限。

不同观点：
• **谨慎质疑派**：该材料目前只是“半生物膨胀泡沫”，研究并未验证其保持气密和承受居住压力的能力；完整栖息地还需机械支撑、隔热、防辐射、防尘、可维修等功能，因此很可能仍要依赖99%左右的传统结构，称其为火星建筑材料可能带有营销色彩。  
• **积极支持派**：即使不能作为唯一建材，也可以用于复合结构，或用于不需要承受大气压力的建筑部件，因此仍具有实际和探索价值。  
• **进一步疑问**：材料据称可分解再利用，但前提是至少有一个酵母细胞存活；评论者质疑火星环境中的辐射是否会影响这一机制，以及这种简单微生物是否足够耐受。

补充讨论：评论还涉及媒体报道是否夸大或戏谑化该研究。争议焦点在于：这是具有潜在工程应用的创新材料，还是被“火星”概念包装后被过度宣传的早期实验成果。

offbeat
Mars astronauts could live in houses made of yeast and jello, say scientists
Low-energy 3D printing could turn Martian dirt into sturdy structures
Brandon Vigliarolo
Brandon
Vigliarolo
GOVERNMENT AND IT NEWS REPORTER
Published
fri 11 Sep 2026 // 17:50 UTC
READ MORE
Britain's technology brief is now everyone's job and nobody's responsibility
1 day ago
Chinese researchers find egg-cellent way to keep space debris from scrambling craft
3 days ago
Britain reboots its space strategy with £7.8B already on the launchpad
5 days ago
Time lords prepare to kick leap seconds into the next millennium
7 days ago
BepiColombo sheds its ride and starts the final glide to Mercury
8 days ago
If humans ever make it to Mars - and that’s still a big IF - they will need to build shelters there. And they could build those shelters out of yeast and gelatin, if a method described by Hong Kong-based researchers makes it out of the lab.
A paper
published
on Thursday by a group of researchers from The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University describes a method for building structures on Mars that doesn’t rely on energy-intensive heating to turn regolith into building blocks. The team instead turned to bioengineered yeast and gelatin mixed with simulated Mars dirt to 3D print structures.
"My inspiration came from freeze-dried fruits that become harder,” senior author Jishen Qiu, an associate professor at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology,
told
Cell Press, the publisher of the paper.
REG AD
Qiu’s idea is a relatively simple one once you break it down: Take one part yeast bioengineered to produce adhesive proteins that bind the components. Combine with artificial gelatin hydrosol to serve as a growth medium for the yeast. Add plain old Martian dirt, and extrude the material through a 3D-printing nozzle.
REG AD
If everything works as intended, the recipe should create a foamy substance that, when exposed to the dry, cold Martian atmosphere, essentially freeze-dries. As the ice sublimates into vapor, you should be left with a light, porous, but incredibly strong material. According to the researchers, that’s exactly what they got.
“The hardened material achieved mean compressive and flexural strengths of approximately 12 and 6 MPa, respectively,” the team said. For reference, that’s roughly the same strength as low-grade terrestrial concrete. As an added perk, the team noted, the energy demand is one to two orders of magnitude lower than that of heat-processing Martian (or lunar, for that matter) dirt into building material.
According to the paper, the material can be broken down and reused too - provided at least a single yeast cell survives the process, and the cold, barren wasteland of Mars, that is. The team isn’t sure that would necessarily be the case, but nothing is stopping Martian yeast masters from keeping a supply on hand for future projects just in case.
The structures they built and tested in their simulated Martian conditions were tiny little beehive-shaped things, measuring just 45 mm tall (a little under 2 inches).
“Is there any physical law or fundamental mechanism that prevents us from doing this?" Qiu asks of his work. "I can't see any at this point in time.”
Qiu said his team is confident that it can scale the tech, but that’s not the only thing that needs to be tested more fully. Per the paper, testing the ability of the yeast-gelatin building foam to retain the pressure necessary to keep humans from succumbing to the Martian elements was outside the scope of the research.
“A practical lunar or Martian habitat must integrate pressure retention, gas tightness, mechanical support, thermal regulation, radiation shielding, dust protection, repairability, and resource recycling,” the paper notes. “These requirements will likely require hybrid architectures” that include both the yeast foam and more traditional structures.
Either way, avoiding the need to heat Martian dirt could reduce the energy and heavy equipment required to build structures there. That’ll be important if we ever actually want to get to Mars. But if we get there, at least we’ll have
yeast
. ®

data.author: petalmind
data.article_summary: 该项目展示了20个独立的LaTeX示例，用于制作复古科学论文风格的页面和插图。内容涵盖历史字体、版式、报纸、目录、表格、星图、显微图、曲线图及专利图纸等，并结合TikZ、PGFPlots、LuaTeX和fiziko MetaPost绘制光学、力学、天文等科学图示。所有示例均可单独编译、修改和复用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：该项目通过线条渲染和字体设计，重现19世纪末至20世纪初的出版物视觉风格，同时引发了关于历史文献数字化的联想。

不同观点：
• [mjmas] 说明插图使用 `fiziko` 实现更美观的线条渲染，强调技术工具对视觉效果的作用。  
• [3eb7988a1663] 误以为项目是将经典历史出版物转写为 LaTeX，例如牛顿引力理论或居里夫人镭研究的论文。他认为许多重要文献目前只有质量很差的扫描件，若能数字化重制将很有价值。  
• [userbinator] 认为 README 和示例的措辞有些像 Claude 生成，但不影响项目呈现出的复古风格；他判断这种19世纪末至20世纪初的美学主要来自字体选择，而非其他设计因素。

补充讨论：评论之间存在“项目实际功能”与“项目可能用途”的偏差：第二条评论讨论的是历史文献转写这一潜在方向，第一条则澄清了当前项目的绘图实现。争议焦点主要是复古视觉效果的来源，集中在字体选择是否起决定性作用。

Vintage scientific papers with LaTeX
Twenty small examples show independent mechanisms behind a convincing
old-scientific-paper aesthetic. Each file is deliberately standalone: copy one,
compile it, and remove individual effects to see what they contribute.
The examples fall into three groups: pure LaTeX pages (1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 10 to
14), standalone
fiziko
MetaPost
figures (3, 7, 8, 9), and LaTeX pages with fiziko figures drawn inside them by
LuaTeX's built-in MetaPost (15 to 20).
Gallery
Low-resolution previews of the compiled output; the PDFs themselves are
vector and searchable.
01 early modern page
02 engraved optics plate
03 Hooke apparatus
04 ornamented incipit
05 Victorian newspaper
06 natural history catalogue
07 lens rays
08 Atwood machine
09 shading atlas

12 snow-crystal micrographs

The examples
01-early-modern-page.tex
-- OpenType
old-style figures and historical ligatures, an explicit long
s
, warm paper
and ink colors, asymmetric margins, a drop capital, spaced small capitals,
marginalia, and printer's rules.
02-engraved-optics-plate.tex
--
deterministic irregular strokes and line hatching in TikZ, with labels kept
as real searchable text.
03-fiziko-hooke-apparatus.mp
--
a compact Hooke apparatus drawn with the external
fiziko
MetaPost library: hatched
support, modeled spring, hanging weight, and measured extension.
04-ornamented-incipit.tex
-- an A5
early-scientific title page with a boxed three-line initial and a small
vector ornament made from ordinary TikZ paths.
05-victorian-newspaper.tex
-- a
compact square broadsheet with a masthead, balanced columns, rule between
columns, pull quotation, article heads, and meteorological register.
06-natural-history-catalogue.tex
-- a museum catalogue page using hanging entries, dot leaders, explicit
typographic roles, and old-style numeric data.
07-fiziko-lens-rays.mp
-- a glass lens
whose ray paths are computed by fiziko's refraction macro rather than drawn
to a predetermined focal point.
08-fiziko-atwood-machine.mp
-- an
Atwood machine composed from a hatched support, shaded pulley, curved rope,
hanging weights, and acceleration arrow.
09-fiziko-shading-atlas.mp
-- a
side-by-side comparison of line shading, stippling, and a variable-width
shaded tube.
10-lua-table-of-logarithms.tex
-- a five-place table of logarithms whose every digit is computed by a
Lua function at compile time, set in lining tabular figures with the
ruling of a nineteenth-century table.
11-circumpolar-star-chart.tex
-- a polar star chart: one macro converts right ascension and declination
to chart coordinates for thirty-four catalogued stars, hour circles
lettered in roman numerals, and magnitude-graded discs.
12-snow-crystal-micrographs.tex
-- four circular microscope fields; the crystals are grown by TikZ
Lindenmayer-system grammars, with six rotated copies of one arm supplying
the hexagonal symmetry.
13-cooling-curve-graph-paper.tex
-- a pgfplots chart on sepia graph paper with inward ticks, open-circle
plotting symbols, a hand-fitted curve, and an italic marginal remark.
14-patent-drawing-sheet.tex
--
a patent-office plate of a centrifugal governor: numbered leader lines,
sections hatched at forty-five degrees, engraved balls, and witness and
inventor signature lines.
15-fiziko-inclined-plane.tex
-- a treatise page whose figure is drawn by fiziko inside LuaLaTeX: a
wooden wedge, a shaded ball, and the weight resolved along and normal to
the slope, with labels set in the page's own text and math fonts.
16-fiziko-telescope-plate.tex
-- a Keplerian telescope in which every ray is refracted by fiziko's
tracing macro; the focus and the exit pupil, where the eye is placed, are
found where computed rays cross the axis.
17-fiziko-terrestrial-globe.tex
-- the earth from three stations using fiziko's globe with its built-in
coastlines, plus a border row of small globes turned by equal steps.
18-fiziko-mechanics-primer.tex
-- a two-column chapter with a loaded cart, a lever in balance, and a
pendulum, each drawn in place in its column.
19-fiziko-knots-plate.tex
--
trefoil, cinquefoil, and septafoil cords from one formula each, with
fiziko finding the crossings and shading the rope.

data.title: Operation Smart Kettle – Börzels Blog
data.author: marbartolome
data.article_summary: 文章记录作者对智能电热水壶的拆解与网络分析：设备通过自建热点完成配网，仅开放6668端口，手机并不直接连接水壶，而是通过TLS加密与Azure云通信。水壶使用涂鸦（Tuya）物联网模块和云服务。作者尝试搭建伪热点抓包，并了解到可能通过刷固件摆脱云端控制，但该设备暂不支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕联网电热水壶的设计缺陷、离线控制、设备破解方式，以及智能家电是否需要开放接口展开讨论。

不同观点：
• 质疑云端依赖：断网后无法通过应用控制水壶，评论者认为设备应提供本地服务器或离线控制能力，而不应依赖厂商服务。
• 倡导开放接口：有人指出，频繁出现“破解家电”的案例，说明市场缺少通用硬件接口。设备应允许用户离线操作、无需专有应用，并可在厂商服务器不可用时继续工作。
• 技术破解路线：多位评论者认为设备可能采用 Beken 或 Tuya 芯片，可通过暴露的引脚刷入 OpenBeken 等固件；也可利用 Tuya 开发者账号、令牌或本地控制方案接管设备。有人还提到曾在 bootloader 模式下实现代码执行，但未能提取密钥。
• 提供替代方案：一名用户表示其 Govee 水壶支持蓝牙，可配置 Wi-Fi、开关水壶并读取温度，愿意封装成开源项目。
• 语义与玩笑：有人纠正“水壶不是茶壶”；“418”对应 HTTP“I'm a teapot”，另有评论借此讽刺德国黑客把精力用于破解家电，而非创业。

补充讨论：争议焦点在于智能家电应依赖云服务，还是必须支持本地、开放、可持续的控制方式；技术上可行的破解方案与普通用户实际可用性之间也存在差距。

49644784.article_content:
Last saturday while grocerie shopping I saw a wifi controlled "Smart Kettle" in the special offers isle. This reminded me of the as april fools joke written HTTP status code
418 "I'm a tea pot"
and posted jokingly this toot on mastodon.
Well the itch got worse and so I finally bought  one of these high tech devices to boil some water.
Since I had not yet done any projects or hacking on smart wifi IoT devices ,I had no idea how it works and what I had to expect. My first thought was, the smartphone app talks directly to the smart kettle, on which runs some kind of server / api one could talk to.
First things first, I hooked up the kettles base to mains power and pushed the wifi button on it. It beeped, flashed and who would have guessed, it spawned it's own open access point. ;)
I was able to connect to it but it did not distribute IPs via DHCP.
For the next try, I installed the Lidl Smart Home App on my smartphone, run the initial setup where I entered my wifi credentials, connected to the kettles own wifi  from where the data was transferred to it. After some beeping the kettle connected to my wifi and it was available in the app.
Here I have the amazing options to set the water temperature for boiling and a time for warm keeping. It also offers some predefined "programs" / temperatures for different teas etc.. Also the status of the kettle and water temperature is shown.
There is a calender icon at the bottom but it is not possible to schedule a boil.
Thanks to the fritzbox notification about new devices on the network I already got it's IP. With that I run a nmap scan to see what is running on the kettle.
It was one port open, TCP 6668 but nmap could not identify what is running here.
I tried to grab a banner via netcat.
nc 192.168.178.70 6668
Connection could be established but I did not get any banner back, giving hints what is running.
Visiting  http or https://192.168.178.70:6668 in the browser also failed.
Would have been to easy. ;)
So next up, trying to setup a fake access point for a man in the middle attack to see what traffic flows between the smartphone and kettle.
For that I had a Kali vm running and a alpha usb wifi dongle connected to it. The home wifi from the host OS is connected to the vm as wired network on eth0.
I disable the network manager service, since it overrides the manual set IPs on the interfaces
sudo systemctl stop NetworkManager.service
Configured a fix IP on eth0 and set default route to the homerouter (fritzbox)
sudo ifconfig eth0 192.168.66.129/24 up
sudo route add default gw 192.168.66.2 eth0
set fix IP on  wlan0
sudo ifconfig wlan0 10.0.0.1/24 up
set iptables rules to forward traffic from wlan0 to eth0
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sudo iptables -P FORWARD ACCEPT
sudo iptables --table nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
configure and run dhcp server
cat dnsmasq.conf
interface=wlan0
dhcp-range=10.0.0.10,10.0.0.250,12h
dhcp-option=3,10.0.0.1
dhcp-option=6,10.0.0.1
server=8.8.8.8
log-queries
log-dhcp
cat fakehosts.conf
127.0.0.1 test.de
sudo dnsmasq -C dnsmasq.conf -H fakehosts.conf -d
configure and run ap service
cat hostapd.conf
interface=wlan0
driver=nl80211
ssid=fake
channel=1
sudo hostapd ./hostapd.conf
start wireshark and listen on wlan0
With the fake wifi set up I reset the kettle and run the initial setup in the app again. These time I configured it to use the fake wifi. And look at that - the setup worked and I can see the traffic from the app and the kettle.
A bit disappointed, I could not see any traffic directly between the app and the kettle.
Only traffic to IPs in the azure cloud. The kettle regularly connects to the cloud via a tls 1.2 encrypted connection and I guess pushes the state and tries to pull new commands.
Now my thought was, how can we break the tls connection to see what is going on. Since we are the man in the middle / access point we could try to deliver the kettle a fake certificate so we can encrypt the traffic and forward it encrypted with the public key from the azure server to normally to the cloud. Ettercap or bettercap could do that as far as I know but I haven´t tried it in the end.
Instead I did a quick
MAC address lookup
to see who build the wifi module, Tuya. New name, let's ask aunt google. And here we see tuya.com, seems to be a big "IoT" as a service provider. You can build devices with their modules or finished products, put your logo on it, click together a control app and use the Tuya cloud servers as backend.
If you had a wifi IoT device in your hand, chances seems to be quite high that it's one of tuyas.
But hey, what do we have here? A full developer documentation on the hardware, api & co.
https://developer.tuya.com/en
. Seems they don´t speak
HTCPCP
:(
Thanks to replies to my toot (thanks
Zach
) , I learned that it was possible to flash the wifi controller via ota firmware to put a "freed" firmware on it to run it without the tuya cloud.  But it seems my device is to young for that.
https://community.home-assis
